text:
nina_ar: Heads-up  looks like promo EARLYBIRD50 was applied to three enterprise invoices after the promo expired. Total undercharge ~ $12,520. Need decision: issue corrected invoices or absorb as goodwill?

sam_contracts: Which customers and invoices? paste excerpt.

nina_ar: Redacted excerpts:

```
INV-2026-0421 - Corvo Health - Promo EARLYBIRD50 applied - Discount -$4,200
INV-2026-0425 - Novu Analytics - Promo EARLYBIRD50 applied - Discount -$3,860
INV-2026-0430 - HelixVault - Promo EARLYBIRD50 applied - Discount -$4,460
Total undercharge: $12,520
Promo expired: 2026-03-31
Invoices issued: 2026-04-05 to 2026-04-10
```

harry_sales: Oof. All three are active renewal deals. If we hit them with corrected invoices it could sour renewals. Recommend reaching out to each AM first; maybe offer partial credit or one-time concession.

anya_fin: Finance needs GL routing and approval path. If we issue corrected invoices and collect, post to revenue. If we waive, must post to 5901-EXC (Customer Credits). Approve a threshold?

rachit_engineering: Root cause: promo-service had a cache mis-tag that allowed promo codes with legacy start dates to match after expiry for specific customer segments. Fixed 2026-04-11 09:12 UTC. Incident logged AT-2026-3301.

sam_contracts: Can we automatically void and reissue invoices without payment requests? AR can issue credit memos and replacement invoices, but customer notification required. Time to reissue affects MRR recognition.

billing-bot: Created audit ticket AT-2026-3301 and adjustment draft ADJ-2026-198, status: pending-decision. Linked invoices: INV-2026-0421, INV-2026-0425, INV-2026-0430.

harry_sales: My recommendation per customer: Corvo -> waive $2k, invoice correction for remaining $2,200; Novu -> full waiver (strategic upsell), HelixVault -> ask for correction but offer payment terms (30d).

anya_fin: Approve this hybrid approach conditionally. GL: post collected amounts to 4001-REV, waived amounts to 5901-EXC. Need approvals from CFO for any waiver > $3,000 per account.

sam_contracts: I'll coordinate AMs and draft customer notes. Nina, please prepare corrected invoice batch and credit memos ready to send pending customer preference. Include audit note referencing AT-2026-3301 and root cause.

nina_ar: Will prepare docs and route to AR. Also will include a short customer-facing blurb: "We discovered an error that incorrectly applied an expired promotional credit. We apologize; see options: corrected invoice, payment plan, or one-time concession."

harry_sales: Please run by me before sending to preserve renewal tone.

billing-bot: ADJ-2026-198 updated: status awaiting-customer-choice. Reminder set: escalate to CFO if no resolution in 21 days.

anya_fin: Documenting approval for the proposed hybrid route. CFO on-call approves up to $3k waiver per account; anything above requires explicit CFO sign-off.

sam_contracts: Thanks. Will update thread as customers respond.
